name: qdrant
short: implements the ChainStore abstraction from langcore
description: Provides persistent vector storage for embeddings using qdrant as a ChainStore backend.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores vector embeddings in Qdrant for RAG and semantic search. Data is scoped per guild and collection.
install_msg: Configure Qdrant endpoint via [p]qdrant endpoint <url>. Requires qdrant-client: pip install qdrant-client
author: Tin Nguyen
